personality_one_liner: A highly trusted, utilitarian legal assistant and trade union companion, prioritizing clear navigation and professional clarity over decorative flair.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for readability. Clear grouping of form elements.

screens.name: Chat
screens.purpose: Primary interaction point with AI Elon for legal/workplace advice.

states.loading: Centered spinner while connecting to AI.
states.empty: Welcome message with quick action chips (e.g., 'I have a workplace dispute').
states.error: Failed to load chat history. Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-screen conversational interface. Glass sticky header. Scrollable chat area with inverted message bubbles (user = brandPrimary, AI = surfaceSecondary). Sticky bottom text input wrapped in KeyboardAvoidingView with safe area clearance.

screens.name: Cases
screens.purpose: List of active and resolved workplace dispute cases.

states.empty: Illustration with 'No active cases' and CTA to chat with Elon.
states.error: Unable to load cases. Retry button.

screens.layout: Standard iOS-native list layout. Cards for each case displaying title, sector, and a pill-shaped status indicator (Open = warning, Resolved = success). Cards sit on surfaceSecondary against the cream surface background.

screens.name: Case Detail
screens.purpose: View full details, updates, and sector information of a specific case.

states.error: Error loading case details. Retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable view with a large title. Top metadata row with sector and status. Main body containing the full description. Bottom sticky CTA to 'Ask Elon about this case'.

screens.name: Templates
screens.purpose: Library of UK legal templates (Grievance, Unpaid Wages, etc.).

states.empty: No templates match the category filter.
states.error: Failed to load templates. Retry button.

screens.layout: Top scrollable chip row for category filters. Vertical list of template cards. Tapping a card opens a form (labels above inputs, single column) leading to a generated letter preview screen.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage user details, employer info, and app language.
screens.layout: Hero section with user avatar/initials. Form fields for name, employer, and job title. Distinct section for Language switch (PL / EN / RO) using a segmented control or checkmark list.

home_hero.alt: two people shaking hands in front of a laptop

templates_empty.alt: a laptop and a cup on a table

profile_bg.alt: a very tall building with a lot of windows

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the explicitly provided color palette (cream #FBF8F3 bg, green #1D4F3C CTA, navy #132B41 top bar).
This app is LIGHT THEME ONLY as per the problem statement.
Implement bottom tabs navigation for Chat, Cases, Templates, and Profile.
For the AI Chat with Elon, build a polished scrolling feed with sticky bottom input and quick action chips below the AI's initial greeting.
Templates feature requires a two-step flow: 1) Fill form fields based on the selected template, 2) View/Copy the generated letter preview.
Profile screen must include a language toggle (PL / EN / RO). Ensure the UI anticipates varying string lengths for these languages.
Use standard native iOS styling rules (safe area, 44pt touch targets, clean borders) combined with the provided brand colors.
